The '''Jag Crag Gorge''' was a steep-sided gorge near [[Arch Canyon/Legends|Arch Canyon]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. Its twisting channel was marked with spires and outcroppings. The gorge was used during [[Podracing/Legends|podraces]] held by [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]] and led racers into [[Jett's Chute/Legends|Jett's Chute]].
